title: 桜花賞の後に・迷えるloser

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka runs the first race of the Classics and loses to Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both ran with all they had and, in the midst of an argument, promise to have a rematch. However… Vodka's next scheduled race is the long-awaited Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to face her rival, Vodka would have to give up on the Japanese Derby and continue with the Japanese Oaks on the Tiara tour instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka is shaken, uncertain as to which path she should choose.
